text:
Alex: quick evening readout — embedding-service p99 jumped to ~1.2s after the 20:10 deploy (r2026.03.17-004). Saw increased queueing on west replicas.
Samira: ack, saw alerts. Any obvious error spikes in the logs?
Alex: yes, KV cache warm errors: repeated 503s from kv-proxy during startup. snippet: ```ERROR kv-proxy: warm cache request failed status=503 retry=3```
Matt: rolled the deploy back at 20:18 to r2026.03.17-003 and traffic recovered. Rolling window shows latency back to baseline ~120ms in canary.
Jia: thanks — was the rollback automatic via the rollout policy or manual?
Matt: manual. Canary alerts didn't auto-fail because cpu stayed low; latency trigger wasn't wired to the canary health check. Filed a tiny follow-up: https://redwood.internal/issue/INC-5473
Samira: mitigation we applied: increased batch window from 10ms -> 30ms on shard group west-1, re-enabled prefix caching on the dedicated pool, and temporarily disabled quantize-fast path for that model variant.
Alex: current status: traffic routed to stable pool, west-1 at 95% healthy, embed requests falling to p99 ~150ms. KV proxy team is investigating the warm path.
ops-bot: Status update: alert RESOLVED for embedding-service p99 spike (incident 2026-03-17-5473). No ongoing PagerDuty pages.
Jia: next steps I have: 1) KV proxy root cause analysis (Samira + infra) 2) Add p99 latency to canary health checks (Matt) 3) Postmortem draft (Alex) — aim to have initial draft by tomorrow 14:00 UTC.
Samira: also propose we add a quick smoke at deploy time that exercises cache warm endpoint (5 requests) and fail fast if >25% errors. I'll draft the test.
Matt: FYI I'm going to open a PR to include p99 in canary checks and add a deploy smoke. Ping me for review @Jia.
Alex: handoff complete for my shift. No open P0s. If anything regresses, please page pagers on-call. :thumbsup:
Samira: noted, taking over watch for the next few hours.
Jia: thanks — picking up follow-ups, will update thread with postmortem link when ready.
